_readme: Copy to basket.<chainId>.json (46630 = Robinhood Chain Testnet) and replace every placeholder with a real address from docs.robinhood.com/chain, data.chain.link and Uniswap's deployment list. The deploy script checks each address on-chain and refuses to deploy if anything is missing or wrong.
name: Hedgerow Equity Basket

components._optional_two_hop: add "via": <USDC address> and "viaFee": 500 if there is no direct WETH pool
